title: Oscar Winner
description: Hayao Miyazaki's masterpiece won the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, marking the studio's second Oscar win since Spirited Away.

title: Honorary Palme d'Or
description: The Cannes Film Festival awarded Studio Ghibli an honorary Palme d'Or, the first time in history this award was given to a group rather than an individual.

title: Ghibli Park Expansion
description: The final area of the Ghibli Park, inspired by Kiki's Delivery Service and Howl's Moving Castle, is now officially open to the public.
